_comment: TEMPLATE (not a prototype): earnings figure from an SEC filing (EDGAR XBRL)
claim: Apple Inc. (CIK 0000320193) reports fiscal-year 2026 total net sales of at least 450 billion USD in its Form 10-K filed on or before 2026-11-30T00:00:00Z.

elements.q: Do the exhibits show an Apple Inc. Form 10-K for fiscal year 2026, filed on or before 2026-11-30T00:00:00Z, with RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax of at least 450000000000 USD?

custom_definitions: The figure is the XBRL fact in the 10-K itself (form=10-K, fp=FY, fy=2026), filed date from EDGAR; press-release or analyst figures are never used.
A later 10-K/A amendment counts only if filed within 24 hours of the original (REVISION_WINDOW_V1).
SEC fair-access policy requires a descriptive User-Agent; the resolver must send one or it will be blocked (COULDNT_CHECK).
Burden of proof is on YES: an unproven or ambiguous element resolves NO.
Early resolution: YES may be declared at the first qualifying event; NO only at/after the deadline.
Fallback: a blocked, rate-limited or unreachable source is COULDNT_CHECK (never NO); the recovery ladder and the listed fallback source apply, then VOID.
